<div class="card-body">
'''Infantry Mine''' is a [[Light]] [[Weapon]] ([[Automated Weapon]]) from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">対人地雷</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">自分の地雷敷設ドロイドの１体と同じ屋外の位置に配備する。キャラクターがその位置に配備されるか移動してきたなら“爆発”する。ただし、ビークルや宇宙戦闘機を使用して移動してきた場合には爆発しない。運命数を引く。運命数＋２＞能力値なら、キャラクターはロストする。対人地雷もロストする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Infantry-Mine-SWCA-100689.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">その多くは反乱軍のスパイや工作員が、厳重に警備された帝国軍施設の防衛線から盗み出してきたものである。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Infantry Mine.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy at the same exterior location as one of your mine-laying droids. It “explodes” if a character deploys or moves there. It does not explode if that movement used a vehicle or starfighter. Draw destiny. The character is lost if destiny plus 2 exceeds ability. The Infantry Mine is also lost.

'''Lore:'''
Many of them were stolen by Rebel spies and operatives from the defensive line of tightly guarded Imperial facilities.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Lore says many were stolen from a 防衛線 rather than typically stolen from a perimeter.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Infantry Mine]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
